title: Converge package-internal graph rendering
goal: Prove burn-graph itself owns safe cached SVG and PNG artifacts without consumer integration or control of existing user processes.

prompt.objective: Confirm UP05, BDD S04, architecture, CLI Help, and public documentation define one package-owned read-only rendering contract.
instructions: Compare formal Product Private truth with the public JSON surfaces.
Treat consumer-owned rendering or arbitrary output paths as blockers.
doneWhen: SVG is default and PNG is optional.
Output is bounded metadata with a project-relative cache path.
Rendering does not mutate Run revision or events.

prompt.objective: Verify shared Mermaid assets, cache identity, atomic convergence, SVG and PNG validation, isolated browser lifecycle, and exact cleanup.
instructions: Review the real implementation and focused tests.
Treat attachment to an existing browser, broad process termination, unsafe SVG, or partial cache acceptance as blockers.
doneWhen: Viewer and renderer share one Mermaid configuration and asset graph.
Cache hits validate bytes and hash before bypassing the browser.
Only the exact isolated child is stopped and its profile is removed.

prompt.objective: Prove source CLI rendering, cache reuse without a browser, concurrent PNG convergence, revision pruning, missing-browser recovery, and 100-node bounds.
instructions: Use the public CLI as the mutation and artifact entry.
Compare Run revision and events before and after rendering.
doneWhen: Real-browser E2E passes for SVG and PNG.
Five cold and cached 100-node samples pass their budgets.
Missing browser degrades only rendering and leaves no partial artifact.

prompt.objective: Build and install dev.4 outside the source tree and prove packaged rendering remains zero-dependency and within size budgets.
instructions: Use the isolated installer E2E and inspect the exact archive.
Treat missing renderer assets or Product Private package content as blockers.
doneWhen: The installed CLI renders a real SVG from packaged assets.
Archive is below 2 MiB and installed content below 5 MiB.
The package declares zero dependencies and excludes Product Private files.

prompt.objective: Choose pass only when every M04 rendering exit gate has concrete evidence and no blocker remains.
instructions: Use the final diff, full verification, package measurements, and this Run's rendered artifact.
Route repair for any confirmed CLI, safety, cache, package, or performance blocker.
doneWhen: Exactly one declared route is returned with concrete evidence.
